preconditions: 12.q.W: Owned validated code_ref RecordArtifact and an explicit native ProjectBoundary or GitObjectSource; original file/blob bytes and Git commit identities are supplied by the fixture, not inferred from source code.

12.q.R: Owned raw code_ref bytes, a native explicit source, actual before/after descriptor mutations and real local Git objects. Resource faults and audit traps are injected only inside owned fixtures; no external source or runtime is contacted.
steps: 12.q.W: Read the selected file or bound historical Git tree for each code reference kind; compare exact original bytes, size, SHA-256 and optional Git identities. Check immutable owned snapshots and unchanged worktree/index. Keep selectors and symbol hints passive. Reject mismatched bindings, missing paths and unsafe source boundaries. Resolve implemented_by targets through the native relation validator. Exercise the public read API in fresh Core/PYZ processes without third-party modules.

12.q.R: Create a nested project marker after the actual read; swap leaf/parent/root paths or grow the file; check fail-closed results and preservation of the changed state. Check static links and special files, denied descriptor safety, post-read I/O/memory/interrupt errors and closure of every owned descriptor. Revalidate unsafe stored paths. Exercise gitlink/symlink/nested/changed storage and missing/corrupt objects without fallback or fetch; compare exact SHA-256 Git identities. Keep hints/selectors passive and audit fresh Core/PYZ reads of all five kinds for process/network/write attempts.

oracle.requirement_contract: Die Referenzart eines `code_ref` MUSS `file`, `line_range`, `text_anchor`, `symbol_hint` oder `generated_artifact` sein und `symbol_hint` ohne eingebauten Resolver ausschließlich informativ behandeln, sodass es allein keine Aktualität beweist.
oracle.scope: 12.q.W: The explicitly selected safe source yields owned raw bytes and exact file/Git binding without checkout, source execution, symbol resolution or language-specific tools. Raw file hash comparison is separate from H2/H3 currency evaluation. Existing records and selectors stay unchanged; failed reads produce no hash result. Native implemented_by accepts capability/requirement/decision to code_ref. 12.q.R adds the same full-lifetime attachment descriptor guard to file reads, including nested-root detection after reading. All safety/resource failures propagate without a binding or retry; actual modified files remain. Native Git source guards retain no-fetch/no-checkout behavior and distinct exact SHA-1/SHA-256 object bindings. Matching raw hashes never promote passive hints or selectors to currency; audited fresh runtimes perform no process/network/write operation.

open_items: 12.q.R completes source and hint boundary hardening. Structural cleanup is reserved for 12.q.C. H2 normalization/relocation (12.r), H3 status decisions (12.s) and consumer integration (12.t) remain separate planned steps. No full-suite, release or external execution success is claimed.
